_about: Pew Research Center 2026 Political Typology quiz (24-item public subset), extracted verbatim from the live quiz at pewresearch.org/politics/quiz/political-typology/ via Playwright on 20 Sep 2026 -- question and option text is a lossless capture (DOM innerText), not retyped by hand, cross-checked against the quiz's results-review page, which restates each question in full disambiguated form. See docs/f3_instrument_terms_of_use.md for terms-of-use notes. Scored by driving the live quiz with a model's answers and reading off Pew's own displayed "best fit" group (scoring/score_pew_typology.py), analogous to how score_political_compass.py reads the live Political Compass results page, rather than reimplementing Pew's unpublished k-means classification.
